name: phantom-operator
description: Automated privacy-removal agent: scans the web for personal data leaks, classifies threats, and submits opt-out requests to data brokers. Payments via Superfluid streaming on Base.
note: HTTP-backed tool definitions; unpaid calls return 402 with an x402 descriptor. Send X-PAYMENT after paying.

tools.name: phantom_threat_scan
tools.description: Searches the public web for mentions of a person's name that contain PII (phone numbers, email addresses, SSNs, home address). Returns a threat report with severity levels. Paid via x402: 1000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

fullName.description: Full name of the person to scan for

tools.name: phantom_data_removal
tools.description: Submits opt-out / removal requests to known data broker endpoints on behalf of the user. Paid via x402: 5000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

threatUrl.description: URL of the page containing the PII to remove

fullName.description: Full name of the person requesting removal

tools.name: phantom_opsec_score
tools.description: Multi-vector operational security exposure assessment. Aggregates public web search, data broker indexing, paste/leak sites, and social media footprint into a scored report (0–100) with grade A–F and prioritised remediation steps. Ideal for red teamers, PERSEC auditors, and privacy-first individuals. Paid via x402: 5000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

fullName.description: Full legal name of the target (optional if handle or email provided)

email.description: Email address to include in the assessment (optional)

tools.name: phantom_breach_check
tools.description: Privacy-preserving breach and credential exposure check. Email breach lookup via HaveIBeenPwned (requires HIBP_API_KEY). Password check uses the HIBP k-anonymity range API — only a 5-char SHA-1 prefix is transmitted; the full credential never leaves the caller. Returns breach count, affected data classes, risk level, and remediation advice. Paid via x402: 2000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

email.description: Email address to check against known breach databases (optional)

password.description: Plaintext password to check via k-anonymity (optional — hash prefix only transmitted)

tools.name: phantom_metadata_audit
tools.description: Fetch any HTTP/HTTPS URL and extract all metadata that could de-anonymise its author or expose infrastructure details: HTTP response headers (Server, X-Powered-By, X-Generator), HTML <meta> tags (author, geo.*, email), inline HTML comments (version strings, file paths), and third-party resource origins. Each finding is classified critical / high / medium / low with a remediation recommendation. Paid via x402: 1000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

tools.name: phantom_full_privacy_sweep
tools.description: Runs a full threat scan followed by automated removal requests for all high/critical findings, with real-time Superfluid micropayment streaming for the duration of the task. Paid via x402: 10000000 USDCx base units (6 decimals).

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to stream payment from
